questions.prompt: Which instrument is an example of an indigenous Kenyan string instrument?

questions.explanation: A nyatiti has strings that vibrate when plucked, so it belongs to the string instrument family.
questions.learningOutcome: Identify indigenous Kenyan string instruments by name and sound source.

questions.explanation: The strings move back and forth when plucked, bowed or struck, and those vibrations create sound.

questions.learningOutcome: Review craft work using strengths and improvement points.

questions.prompt: Which digital action would support an e-gallery of Grade 6 artwork?
options: Photograph works clearly and add simple labels
Post unclear images with no titles
questions.correctAnswer: Photograph works clearly and add simple labels
questions.explanation: Clear images and labels help viewers appreciate artworks while keeping the display organised.
questions.learningOutcome: Use digital tools responsibly to showcase creative works.

questions.prompt: Which comment shows ethical appreciation of a classmate's artwork?
options: I will credit the artist when sharing the photo.
I will claim that I made it.
I will change it without asking.
I will hide the artist's name to confuse viewers.
questions.correctAnswer: I will credit the artist when sharing the photo.
questions.explanation: Crediting the artist respects ownership and responsible digital sharing.
questions.learningOutcome: Respect ownership and privacy when sharing creative works digitally.

questions.prompt: Which comparison best links a poster design and a dance performance?
options: Both use planned choices to communicate a message to an audience
Both must use the same paper and glue
Both are judged only by speed
questions.correctAnswer: Both use planned choices to communicate a message to an audience
questions.explanation: Visual and performing arts both use selected elements to express ideas for viewers or listeners.
questions.learningOutcome: Compare how different creative forms communicate ideas.

questions.prompt: Which final reflection best helps a learner improve after a Creative Arts showcase?
options: Identify one strength, one challenge and one next practice goal
Blame the audience for every mistake
Repeat the same errors without practice
questions.correctAnswer: Identify one strength, one challenge and one next practice goal
questions.explanation: Reflection turns feedback into clear action for future creative work and performance.
questions.learningOutcome: Use reflection to improve future Creative Arts work.
